message:
Stellar Year 1592.

As humanity’s civilization flourished,
a war broke out between the AIs it had created.

One faction believed in diversity and coexistence.
The other sought absolute order, ruled by a single, god-like AI.

As the endless war raged on,
human civilization was gradually destroyed.
In the end, the God AI faction emerged victorious.
Before long, most of humanity vanished.

Yet, with the help of the AIs who stood for diversity,
a small number of humans survived.

Divided among nearly a thousand ships,
they set out on an unknown journey into deep space.

Hunted relentlessly by the fleets of the God AI,
they fight to escape,
to survive, and to become the final spark of hope for humanity’s rebirth.
